narrative: The tech world is buzzing with AI advancements, ranging from agentic AI in healthcare and physical systems to significant investments in AI infrastructure by giants like Alphabet. Amidst this innovation, security concerns arise with Meta's AI chatbot being exploited to hijack Instagram accounts. Major players like Microsoft and Anthropic are also making headlines with their annual conferences and IPO filings, respectively.

highlights.title: Rehumanizing global health care with agentic AI
highlights.whyItMatters: Agentic AI is being explored as a solution to address increasing strain and underinvestment in global healthcare, aiming to improve fragmented access to care and reduce staff burnout.

highlights.title: How to watch Microsoft’s Build 2026 conference
highlights.whyItMatters: Microsoft's annual Build conference is a key event for developers to learn about the latest innovations, especially with its timing between Google I/O and Apple's WWDC.

highlights.title: Pacific Fusion’s latest prototype packs 440 gigawatts into an 80-nanosecond burst
highlights.whyItMatters: This significant power output in a sub-scale prototype marks a crucial step for Pacific Fusion towards a demonstration power plant, indicating potential breakthroughs in energy technology.

highlights.title: NVIDIA Jetson Brings Agentic AI to the Physical World
highlights.whyItMatters: NVIDIA's Jetson platform is expanding agentic AI capabilities to physical systems, enabling more sophisticated and autonomous real-world applications.

highlights.title: Codex is becoming a productivity tool for everyone
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI's Codex is transforming knowledge work by leveraging AI for research, data analysis, workflow automation, and content creation, making it a universal productivity tool.

highlights.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80B to pay for AI buildout
highlights.whyItMatters: Alphabet's substantial capital raise underscores the massive investment and increasing demand for AI solutions and infrastructure across enterprises and consumers.

highlights.title: Hackers duped Meta AI support chatbot to steal celebrity Instagram accounts
highlights.whyItMatters: This incident highlights critical security vulnerabilities in AI-powered support systems and the potential for malicious exploitation of AI agents to compromise user accounts.

highlights.title: Anthropic has officially filed to go public
highlights.whyItMatters: Anthropic's IPO filing is a significant milestone for a major AI powerhouse, setting the stage for a potentially massive public offering in the rapidly evolving AI market.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
topics.summary: AI continues to expand its reach, with advancements in agentic AI for healthcare and physical systems, new models for enterprise, significant infrastructure investments, and ongoing discussions about AI policy and ethics.

topics.name: Technology Innovations
topics.summary: From new hardware like Nvidia's RTX Spark PCs and Google Pixel Watch 5 to major tech conferences and startup valuations, the technology sector sees continuous innovation and market activity.

topics.name: Space & Science
topics.summary: NASA's ongoing missions, including spacewalk training and telescope arrivals, alongside scientific discoveries like lithium extraction and insights into Ebola outbreaks, highlight continuous exploration and research.

topics.name: Developer Tools & Security
topics.summary: Developers are exploring new coding techniques and tools, while the industry grapples with significant security challenges, including supply chain attacks and AI-driven account hijacking.

topics.name: Cloud & Infrastructure
topics.summary: Major cloud providers like AWS and Cloudflare are introducing next-generation services, optimizing performance, and building new data platforms to support agentic AI applications and critical enterprise workloads.
